actor.description: Recorded actor identity, not host-authenticated authority.

file.description: A staged file relative to the work directory. The consumer verifies its actual bytes against sha256.

relativePath.description: A slash-separated file path relative to the work directory; no absolute path, dot segment, parent traversal, drive prefix or backslash.

context.description: Supporting notes and reference files used to understand the task, separate from its inputs. Empty collections explicitly mean no extra context. Context does not grant additional execution authority.
context.title: Request context

decision.description: .works/<workId>/decisions/<id>.json: an attributed decision on an exact work revision and subject digest. Identity and authority are not authenticated by this schema.
decision.title: Decision

evidence.description: .works/<workId>/evidence/<id>.json: artifact metadata. Existence, actual digest and evidentiary relevance require separate checks.
evidence.title: Evidence

index.description: Version 1 of the proposed .works document format. A document must match exactly one kind. This contract does not migrate or reinterpret legacy session records.
index.title: Works document contract

inputs.description: The prompts and files the request asks the skill to act on. At least one prompt or file is required.
inputs.title: Request inputs

output.description: One produced output. Text is inline; commits identify a repository and full object ID; images and other files bind persisted artifacts. Output metadata alone does not prove correctness or publication.
output.title: Response output

request.description: .works/<workId>/requests/<id>.json: prompts and files to act on, with supporting context kept separate, against one work revision. This record alone grants no execution permission.
request.title: Request

response.description: .works/<workId>/responses/<id>.json: typed outputs produced for one request. Optional verification observations describe their checks separately; delivering an output is not a claim that the work is proved complete.

feedbackRound.description: Completed feedback-and-repair rounds for this request. Initial candidate is round zero; the caller maintains truthful history.

response.title: Response

work.description: .works/<id>/work.json: goal, declared scope, acceptance criteria and current lifecycle.
work.title: Work

@cli/python.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/python.note: Resolve Python 3 from the active environment: python, python3, or py -3 as appropriate; record the selected executable and any launcher arguments.

@cli/shell.bind: Resolved executable path and reported version in the active environment; working directory and arguments declared by the invocation.
@cli/shell.note: Resolve to the session shell (PowerShell, bash or another declared shell); do not assume bash on Windows. Arguments remain separate data until encoded for that shell.
@cli/shell.purpose: Run a declared command in the active session shell.

@tools/fileread.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/fileread.purpose: Read declared workspace files and directories through the active session.

claude.via: Claude Code Read, Glob and Grep

@tools/sourcewrite.bind: Capability advertised by the active session; availability and invocation permissions checked at use time.
@tools/sourcewrite.purpose: Edit files within the declared write scope through the active session.

@workspaces/artifacts.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/artifacts.purpose: Produced files, including images, documents and other deliverables.

@workspaces/context.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/context.purpose: Supporting reference files for a request.

@workspaces/inputs.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/inputs.purpose: Files supplied as the subject of a request.

@workspaces/requests.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/requests.purpose: Requests with separate inputs and context.

@workspaces/responses.bind: Explicit absolute root binding from the active invocation; resolve within that root, verify existence when reading, and verify declared write scope before writing.
@workspaces/responses.purpose: Responses declaring produced outputs and execution status.

criteria.stopWhen: Return done only when every criterion passes with accepted criteriaResults. Block on uncertain ownership or side effects. Stop after two feedback rounds or an unchanged repeated failure.

purpose: Apply or roll back one declared data fixture inside an exact environment namespace, then prove the observed state and rollback boundary.

request.description: inputs.prompts must name apply or rollback, environment, store, authorization, exact namespace, expected read-back and runner command. inputs.files carry the immutable seed plan and fixtures; context files may carry account and route records. Never include credential values.
request.title: data.seed request

response.description: A done response records exact affected identities, an exact rollback set and observed state proof. It contains no credential values.
response.title: data.seed response

scope: Only rows and objects enumerated by the supplied seed plan in one bound non-production or explicitly authorized environment. It does not create identities, change schemas, serve runtimes, seed the outcome under test, or touch shared rows.

calls.purpose: Read the declared plan, fixtures and typed provider/store context.

steps.instruction: Read the immutable seed plan, fixtures, environment and store context. Verify authority, operation, account or namespace, expected state, representative volume, exact rollback set and declared runner. Ask when any essential binding is absent; do not draft a plan or expose credentials.
produces: A frozen seed operation and namespace.

reads.when: when route, account or authority context is declared

calls.purpose: Run the request's store observation command against the externally identified store.

steps.instruction: Use the declared read-only command to inventory every planned identity and its namespace before mutation. Classify exact matches, missing rows, owned mismatches, shared rows and uncertain prior effects. The external store is the exact resource identified by supplied typed context.

calls.purpose: Run only the declared idempotent apply or exact rollback command against the externally identified store.
calls.when: after a safe mutation delta is known

calls.purpose: Persist exact secret-free mutation and rollback records.

steps.instruction: For apply, reuse exact matches and create or idempotently update only missing or invalid owned rows. For rollback, remove only the previously recorded rollback set. If a prior call is uncertain, observe stable identities before deciding whether anything remains; never replay blindly.

writes.when: after the external effect is known
after the exact affected set is known

calls.purpose: Run the declared read-back checks against the external store.
Validate the compiled operator request and response.

steps.instruction: Read every expected identity back and compare values, ownership, volume and rollback boundary. Give concrete mismatch feedback and repair only owned rows. Persist raw state proof, evaluate all criteria, then write a response only with the observed outcome.

validate.failurePolicy: Observe before every mutation and after any uncertain effect. Feedback names exact rows or fields; repair only owned rows and reassess. Never repeat an external write until its prior effect is known.

review.instruction: Compare the plan, preflight inventory and mutations. Every affected row or object must be attributable to the declared account or namespace; reject shared or uncertain ownership.
Compare actual read-back with every expected value and representative volume. A partial or unobserved external effect cannot be called applied.
Verify the rollback manifest is a subset of the exact applied set and rollback removes only that set. Reject broad cleanup queries and schema changes.
Inspect requests, transcripts and outputs for credential values or reusable secret material. References by name are allowed; values are not.
